% Beamer source: a full-bleed background image behind one frame, with white text
% over it. The { ... } group is what scopes \usebackgroundtemplate to this frame.
% ltx-talk has no \usebackgroundtemplate -- "! Undefined control sequence"
% (C-BACKGROUND). The danger is not the error, it is the repair: stub the command
% out and the frame still compiles, still has the right page count, and renders
% white text on a white page.
%
% The second frame is here to pin the SCOPE: beamer's { ... } group ends the
% template, and the conversion must end it too.
%
% example-image-16x9.pdf ships with TeX Live (the mwe package), so this fixture
% needs no asset of its own.
\documentclass[aspectratio=169]{beamer}
\usepackage{graphicx}

\begin{document}
{
\usebackgroundtemplate{\includegraphics[width=\paperwidth]{example-image-16x9}}%
\begin{frame}[b]{Warning}
\begin{itemize}
  \item \color{white} White text over the image
  \item<2-> \color{white} Second overlay, still white
\end{itemize}
\end{frame}
}
\begin{frame}{After the group}
The background must not leak onto this page.
\end{frame}
\end{document}
